title: Clean up Coolify
subtitle: First check that everything is in Tugra, then remove what Coolify left on the server.
intro: Nothing is removed by checking. Docker volumes are never listed for removal.
listNone: Coolify left nothing to remove here.
unreadable: This Coolify read does not say, so it cannot count as complete.
complete: Everything Coolify had is in Tugra.
incompleteNote: Fix what is missing first. Cleaning stays closed until the list is complete.

failure.control_plane: This server runs Coolify itself. It is retired separately.
failure.no_coolify_link: Read the Coolify first: no stored read knows this server.
failure.agent_error: The agent could not run it.
failure.scan_unreadable: The list from the server was cut short, so nothing was trusted.
failure.no_docker: Docker is not available on this server.
failure.partial: Some of it could not be removed. Look at the list.
failure.recheck: What you confirmed is removed. More is free to remove now: check again to see it.
failure.read_stale: The stored Coolify read is too old. Read the Coolify again first.

error.forbidden: Only a team owner can do this.
error.offline: The agent on this server is offline.
error.incomplete: Something is still missing in Tugra. Nothing was removed.
error.list_changed: The list changed. Look at it again.
error.not_ready: This check is not ready to confirm.
error.cleanup_active: A cleanup is already running on this server.
error.control_plane: This server runs Coolify itself. It is retired separately.
error.read_stale: The stored Coolify read is too old. Read the Coolify again first.
error.confirm_name_mismatch: That is not the server's name.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.

confirmBody: This removes the {n} items listed as "Will be removed" from {server}. Your Docker volumes are not touched. "Give back to Coolify" stops working afterwards.
